details.description: Code Llama - Python 7B is Meta's Python-specialized variant of Code Llama 7B, additionally trained on about 100 billion tokens of Python code on top of the base checkpoint for stronger Python completion. It is a raw code-completion model, not instruction- or chat-tuned, and does not support infilling. Meta's Code Llama GitHub repository was archived (read-only) on July 1, 2025, and Code Llama is absent from Meta's current model documentation, which now centers on newer Llama releases.
advantages: Additionally trained on about 100 billion tokens of Python code beyond the base model, per Meta's launch post.
Scores 38.4% pass@1 on HumanEval and 47.6% pass@1 on MBPP (Meta's Code Llama paper, Table 2).
Trained on sequences of up to 16k tokens.
disadvantages: Specialized for Python; Meta positions it for Python rather than general multi-language code tasks.
Does not support infilling, per Meta's launch post, unlike the base and Instruct 7B/13B variants.
Trained only on data collected through July 2023.
Meta's Code Llama GitHub repository was archived in July 2025 and the family is absent from Meta's current model documentation.
use_cases: Base model for fine-tuning on Python-heavy coding tasks.
